project_type: .NET 8 Web API — single-project modular monolith, Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web
build_system: dotnet SDK; solution file at $ROOT/DCDSS.sln; project at $ROOT/DCDSS/DCDSS.csproj. Nullable enable, ImplicitUsings enable. No multi-project split.
test_framework: No test project exists yet. The design calls out unit-testable pure classes (CdsRuleEvaluator, ReferenceRangeParser, LabResultSelector, JwtSettingsValidator) but does NOT require a test project to be created as part of this task — dotnet build passing is the verification gate.

test_command: dotnet build "c:\Users\nm\IdeaProjects\Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS)\DCDSS.sln" (no test project; build = verification)
verification_instructions: 1. dotnet build must produce 0 errors, 0 warnings. 2. After DB is available: dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef --version 8.0.33 then cd DCDSS && dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate. 3. If dotnet-ef unavailable, author migration files manually per design Section 13. 4. The app must start (dotnet run --project DCDSS) and Swagger must be reachable at /swagger in Development.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Migrations/ folder — three files: Migrations/<timestamp>_InitialCreate.cs, Migrations/<timestamp>_InitialCreate.Designer.cs, Migrations/DcdssContextModelSnapshot.cs. Generated by dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate from inside $ROOT/DCDSS.
environment_constraints: Windows / PowerShell. All paths containing spaces AND parentheses must be double-quoted. Project directory is 'c:\Users\nm\IdeaProjects\Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS)'. Do NOT run dotnet ef database update without a live MySQL instance — build must pass without a database. AdminSeed__Password and JwtSettings__SigningKey are NOT in source (they are committed as placeholders); do not add real secrets to committed files.
contribution_requirements: Design Rev 2 is the single source of truth (c:\Users\nm\IdeaProjects\Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS)\.agents\tasks\design.md). Do NOT relitigate any decision. Root namespace DCDSS. Sub-namespaces aligned to folders. No placeholder TODOs in core logic. Enums stored as strings. All FKs OnDelete Restrict. IDbContextFactory for audit isolation. No AddDbContext — only AddDbContextFactory. PasswordHash MaxLength 512. DateOnly for DOB.
key_patterns: 1. Fluent API only for entity mapping (no data annotations on entities). 2. Data annotations on DTOs only. 3. IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> per entity in Data/Configurations/. 4. IRepository<T>/IUnitOfWork in Services/Interfaces/ (Core abstractions). 5. Repository<T>/UnitOfWork in Repositories/ (Data implementations). 6. Specific repo interfaces in Repositories/Interfaces/. 7. All enums: HasConversion<string>() + HasMaxLength. 8. All DateTime: UTC (DateTime.UtcNow). 9. Cascade Restrict on all FKs. 10. Singleton: IClinicalRuleStore, IReferenceRangeParser, ITokenService. 11. Scoped: all repos, all services, IUnitOfWork, IAuditLogService, IAdminSeeder. 12. AddDbContextFactory<DcdssContext> only — it also registers a scoped DcdssContext. 13. AuditLogService uses IDbContextFactory<DcdssContext> for isolation. 14. GlobalExceptionMiddleware registered FIRST in pipeline. 15. AddAuthentication before AddAuthorization. 16. FallbackPolicy = RequireAuthenticatedUser. 17. Login = [AllowAnonymous]; every other action has explicit [Authorize(Roles=...)].
